'''Vulanish''' was one of the dialects of [[Olys Corellisi/Legends|Olys Corellisi]] in the times of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. One known Vulanish phrase was [[Hustru fönster]], which found its way into [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="Jedi Healer">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>
